rationale: Email deliverability failures for new domains are a well-documented, recurring pain with clear willingness-to-pay evidence: multiple paid competitors (MXToolbox Pro at $129/yr, GlockApps at $79/mo, Postmark's deliverability tools) serve this exact segment, and community threads across ServerFault, Reddit, and IndieHackers surface this problem multiple times per week. The gap — guided, plain-language remediation for non-technical founders rather than raw diagnostic data — is real and underserved by existing free tools.
